tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Creative Market catalog of fonts, graphics, templates, photos, 3D assets, illustrations, icons, mockups and stock video by keyword, style, mood or subject, e.g. 'retro display fonts for a vinyl record label'. Supports category, price range, staff-pick, on-sale, featured and recency filter

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Return the catalog index record for one product by ID: numeric shop ID, numeric category IDs, eligible file-type IDs, software types, staff-pick and visibility flags, publish date and starting price. This is structured metadata only; it does not include the title, images or description.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product_details, identify_font · Private data: search_products, get_product · Public sink: get_product.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product_details, identify_font · Private data: search_products, get_product · Public sink: get_product

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
